scope: Source-level call-path verification tied to the ten actual saved finite STSP runs; no new fitting, timing or scientific audit.
empirical_target_chart: z(s)=y1+s*T+B*u(s), with B and T from target h2 empirical PCA at y1; solve B^T R_h2(z)=0 at every objective/derivative evaluation.
optimization_parameter: Estimated ambient tangent displacement s, not true curve parameter theta.
finite_operator: Empirical observations only: KDTree support, K6 weighted centered covariance/eigenspaces, empirical residual and derivatives.
root_solver: Zero initial normal coordinate at each y1+s*T; Newton/backtracking on empirical residual; no true-coordinate initializer inside CP.
reference_query_construction: Geometry-assisted common benchmark design. Exact archived y1 coordinates reused; validation reconstructs h1 roots with true gamma/normal_basis.
original_NN_library: Geometry-assisted branch initializers retained from original E4.
global_scope: Numerically checked local fitted sheet, not a formal global closest-point certificate over arbitrary additional components.
continuity_scope: Local implicit-function construction with numerical Jacobian/transversality checks. No globally reconstructed atlas or uniform-curvature certificate.
measured_cost: perf_counter elapsed wall-clock CPU-backend seconds for 32 queries per original parent; ten-parent summary, not cost per query or a universal CP lower bound.
included_cost: Observation-array construction, both STSP indices and weights
CP h2 PCA, implicit chart solves, derivatives, scalar optimization and four normal multistart checks
excluded_cost: True-curve arclength/query-grid generation at finite_experiment.py:52, outside the timers
True-curve projection for Oracle/evaluation and truth metrics
terminology: Empirical local-chart continuous CP benchmark with geometry-assisted common reference queries. The CP target search itself does not use the true parametrization; the full benchmark is not an entirely data-driven end-to-end reconstruction.
